Nice to have • An existing network in the UAE/GCC or Indian distribution and manufacturing community. • Experience with Tally or other accounting tools common among SMEs. • Arabic, Hindi or another regional language. • Experience working with ERP partners, resellers or system integrators. • Familiarity with FMCG, pharma, auto spare parts or industrial supply chains. What we offer • Fully remote role with flexible hours. • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission. • Travel expenses covered for client and partner meetings. • A product that solves urgent, visible problems for SMEs: stockouts, excess stock and supply disruption. • Direct access to the founders and a real say in which markets we enter next. • Room to grow into a regional sales leadership role as the team expands. Which markets you know best. SCMSigma is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
